runOutcomes.title: Run follow-through
runOutcomes.description: Suggest follow-up issues from recorded changes and generate fix prompts after you create the selected issues. stella model calls are metered. Repository evidence and run summaries keep their separate settings.
runOutcomes.platformDisabled: Oxagen has suspended run follow-through for this organization.
runOutcomes.enabled: Metered run follow-through is enabled for this organization.
runOutcomes.disabled: Metered run follow-through is off until an organization owner or admin enables it.
runOutcomes.denied: An organization owner or admin must change this setting.
runOutcomes.saveFailed: The setting could not be saved. Try again.
runOutcomes.ownerRequired: Ask an organization owner or admin to change this setting.
runOutcomes.providerFailed: The connections could not be read. Try again.
runOutcomes.providerConsent: Enable Run follow-through before authorizing an issue provider.
runOutcomes.providerOwner: An organization owner or admin can authorize issue providers.
runOutcomes.githubConnected: The workspace GitHub installation is connected. Issue creation also requires its Issues write permission.
runOutcomes.githubUnconfigured: GitHub authorization is not configured for this deployment.
runOutcomes.linearUnconfigured: Linear authorization is not configured for this deployment.
runOutcomes.linearEmpty: No Linear issue connection is recorded.
runOutcomes.authorizationFailed: Authorization could not start. Check consent and try again.
